description.value: Rocky Point Spirits is Port Moody's first commercial distillery, opened in late 2020 and situated in front of Rocky Point Park with views of the sea and mountains. The indoor lounge accommodates up to 100 guests and serves handcrafted cocktails alongside house-made spirits including low-calorie gin and vodka. Food trucks are typically stationed outside, and bottles and ready-to-drink cocktails can be purchased to go.

address.value: 2805 Murray St, Port Moody, BC V3H1X3

bike_parking_detail: 5 racks within 100m: rack at 16m; stands (12 spaces) at 55m; stands (6 spaces) at 73m; stands (8 spaces) at 83m; stands (8 spaces) at 88m. Total: 34 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Rocky Point Spirits is an active distillery and lounge at 2805 Murray St, Port Moody, matching the OSM address; the business is clearly open and operational. Takeout is explicitly confirmed via the FAQ ('Yes, we sell spirits, cocktails, beer and spiked tea's in various formats') and dedicated 'TAKE HOME SPIRITS' and 'TO-GO COCKTAILS' menu sections. No bike parking, washroom details, water refill information, or Wi-Fi are mentioned anywhere on the site.
